entry_rules.name: Triple Confirmation
entry_rules.description: OI + Price + PCR must ALL align before entry

entry_rules.name: Minimum New Contracts
entry_rules.description: Minimum 200 new contracts — check absolute numbers, not just %

entry_rules.name: No Early Entry
entry_rules.description: No entry before 9:30 AM. Best window is 10:00–11:30 AM

entry_rules.name: No Day High Entry
entry_rules.description: Never enter at day high — wait for pullback

entry_rules.name: Gap Down Wait
entry_rules.description: Gap down open = wait 30 minutes before CE entries

entry_rules.name: Expiry Preference
entry_rules.description: June expiry preferred over May. Last week of May = avoid May options

position_management.name: Immediate SL Exit
position_management.description: SL hit = exit immediately, no hope trading

position_management.name: 1 Lot Book at T1
position_management.description: 1 lot = book at T1, no trailing

position_management.name: Daily Max Loss
position_management.description: Daily max loss = ₹5,000 — stop all trading if hit

position_management.name: PCR First 15 Min Rule
position_management.description: Don't exit June positions based on PCR in first 15 mins — wait 30 mins for trend confirmation

oi_analysis.name: Long Buildup Signal
oi_analysis.description: Fresh OI + price up = long buildup = bullish ✅

oi_analysis.name: PCR + CE OI Double Confirm
oi_analysis.description: PCR + CE OI must BOTH confirm. PCR from put writing ≠ CE buyers active

oi_analysis.name: Sector OI Correlation
oi_analysis.description: Check sector OI correlation before entry

oi_analysis.name: No Deep OTM to Expiry
oi_analysis.description: Never carry deep OTM to last day of expiry

capital_rules.name: SL Cooldown
capital_rules.description: Wait 30 minutes after SL hit before redeploying capital

capital_rules.name: No Late Trades
capital_rules.description: No new trades after 2:30 PM (BTST exception only)

overnight_rules.name: No Weekly Options Carry
overnight_rules.description: Never carry weekly options over weekend

overnight_rules.name: Exit May Losers by Thursday
overnight_rules.description: Exit all losing May positions by Thursday

overnight_rules.name: June Strong Position Trail
overnight_rules.description: June position with 30+ days + OI > 500 real contracts = don't exit on first profit, trail SL instead
